title: Status-update replies from a fresh Assistant conversation reach the phone, and Mac load alerts stop counting as TJ at the laptop

fields.why: TJ's Status update button (13 Nov 14:46 UTC) got no reply on the phone

text: Bridge log ~/Library/Logs/Genlock/phone-bridge.log: 'phone said Status update' 14:46:38, no reply line. Tally answered at 14:48:02 in fresh conversation 72ccc36b (Assistant transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tj-Library-Application-Support-Genlock-Assistant); next fresh one cea11119 at 14:49. TranscriptFollower (mobile/bridge/lib.mjs) never followed 72ccc36b; suspect findAssistant's sessions.json/state.json lag after AppModel.startAssistantFreshIfDue. Also promptSource counts '[Load alert]' as laptop: walk:false and it moves the mark.
Status button now sends WalkPlan.statusRequest (starts 'Status update, a fresh full report'); its reply is walked by reOf even across the clear mark. Fresh-conversation follower gap still open.

When the Assistant's transcript changes (fresh start, or the channel's state.json vanishes), the follower keeps reading the previous conversation's tail, so a reply finished there after the switch still reaches onReply
check: cd mobile/bridge && npm test: new follower test 'a reply finished in the old conversation after a fresh start still arrives' passes

text: A [Load alert] prompt (bare or inside pasted_content) is not counted as TJ at the laptop: no onPrompt, no onMoved, the mark does not move, and its reply walks on the phone
check: cd mobile/bridge && npm test: new follower test for load alerts passes (mark unchanged, answers not 'laptop')

text: Replaying the 13 Nov 14:46 incident transcripts (7f850c30 -> 72ccc36b -> cea11119) through the follower delivers the 14:48:02 status-update reply
check: node scratch replay script prints the reply starting 'Here's where everything stands now'

text: All existing bridge tests still pass

evidence: mobile/bridge test 6 'a reply finished in the old conversation after a fresh start still arrives' ok; same test not ok against HEAD lib.mjs
test 7 load alert: got [['reply','notice',null]], mark 0, walkable true; not ok against HEAD lib.mjs

scratchpad/replay.mjs over 7f850c30/72ccc36b/cea11119, gap and direct modes: before 'STATUS REPLY LOST'; after '14:48:03 Here's where everything stands now... [answers phone]' STATUS REPLY DELIVERED, load alert reply now answers notice
cd mobile/bridge && npm test: 55 pass 0 fail (before new tests); follower.test.mjs 7/7 pass after

fields.symptom: Status-update reply in fresh conversation 72ccc36b (14:48:02) never reached the phone; load-alert replies not walked
fields.root_cause: TranscriptFollower followed only the transcript the channel currently names; when a second fresh start removed the channel at 14:47:48 it stopped reading 72ccc36b mid-turn and jumped to cea11119, dropping the tail. Separately promptSource classed [Load alert] as laptop
whys: follower assumed a conversation is finished once the app stops naming it
fresh starts can end a conversation whose last turn is still being written
fields.corrective: follower keeps reading the last named transcript while nothing is named, and drains a moved-off conversation for 10 min with its own offset and turn state; promptSource returns notice for load alerts

text: Fixed in mobile/bridge/lib.mjs: follower drains a moved-off transcript 10 min and keeps reading while none is named; [Load alert] is source 'notice'. Tests 6-7 in follower.test.mjs; bridge suite 57/57. Live bridge needs restart to pick it up. Uncommitted (awaiting TJ). No phone build needed.

answers.observed: replay of real transcripts: 72ccc36b reply at 14:48:03 delivered after fix, lost before, in both resolver schedules
answers.cause: mechanism reproduced by replay, but the exact resolver schedule at 14:47:48 (null gap vs direct switch) is inferred from the kept copy 2026-11-13T14-47-48-365Z.jsonl, not logged; fix covers both
answers.absence: why a second fresh start fired at 14:47:48 while 72ccc was mid-turn is not established (the fractional-stamp keep is not in current source; possibly an older app build)
answers.assumption: 10-minute drain window is mine: a turn that finishes more than 10 min after a switch is still lost
answers.falsify: next status update from the phone that gets no 'reply' line in phone-bridge.log after the bridge restart

text: spun off T-A83JA: Phone app and Mac Focus Mode notice when updates are stale and send their own status update request before showing them
